newsitem.title: UK: UK'S FTSE TURNS LOWER AFTER DATA, RATE FEARS WEIGH.
newsitem.headline: UK'S FTSE TURNS LOWER AFTER DATA, RATE FEARS WEIGH.

text.p: UK shares had turned lower again ahead of the U.S. opening on Wednesday after higher than expected U.S. price data followed a batch of strong domestic data, putting interest rate concerns back in the spotlight.
The FTSE 100 index was off 10.2 points at 4,346.6 by 1350 GMT. Advancing stocks outweighed losers by roughly five-to-four.

UK stocks extended losses after U.S. February CPI figures showed a rise of 0.3 percent, compared with forecasts of 0.2 percent. The Dow was expected to open lower on worries over a possible early rate hike on March 25, the date of the next FOMC meeting in the U.S.
